newsitem.title: GERMANY: EU rapeseed crop pegged at 8.25 mln T - Oil World.
newsitem.headline: EU rapeseed crop pegged at 8.25 mln T - Oil World.

text.p: European Union rapeseed output could reach 8.25 million tonnes in 1997, the Oil World newsletter said, revising its two-week old projection of an 8.1-8.2 million tonne crop.
Last year's EU crop totalled 7.14 million tonnes.

Oil World cited higher yields in France, where this year's crop might total 3.10 million tonnes (2.90 million in 1996), but added that rainfall could interfere with harvesting elsewhere and this might result in reductions from this latest estimate.
EU rapeseed crushings in 1997/98 (July/June) were forecast at 7.00 million tonnes compared with 6.49 million in 1996/97.
Net rapeseed exports in 1997/98 were forecast at 385,000 tonnes versus just 1,000 estimated for 1996/97.
Oil World said more rape oil output and export availability in the EU had resulted in a discount to soy oil and this could stimulate import demand from North Africa, Asia and elsewhere.
The EU sunseed crop might also be higher than expected, due to upward revisions in Spain and a favourable French outlook.
Oil World estimated it at 3.90 million tonnes, up 300,000 tonnes from its last estimate and versus 3.84 million in 1996.
EU soybean output was put at 1.3 million tonnes, up by 300,000 tonnes from last year.
